# nemau

nemau drives the Nemau Cloud public API: compute, network, storage,
managed Kubernetes and DNS.

Authentication:

```
export NEMAU_ACCESS_KEY_ID=...
export NEMAU_ACCESS_KEY_SECRET=...
# or, for a service account:
export NEMAU_TOKEN=...
export NEMAU_API_URL=https://api.nemau-cloud.com   # optional
```

Project: "nemau project list" to see them, "nemau project use `<project>`" to
pick one. The choice is saved locally and applies to later commands; --project
or NEMAU_PROJECT_ID override it for one invocation. With none of those, the
project the credential carries applies.

Writes are asynchronous: by default the CLI waits for the operation to finish.
--wait=false returns immediately, printing the task id.

Every write carries an idempotency key, generated per command and kept across
the CLI's own retries, so a rate-limited or interrupted request is never
queued twice. To make a re-run of the same command safe too, pass your own
with --idempotency-key: the platform then returns the original task instead of
creating the resource again (for 24 hours).

## Usage

```
nemau [command]
```

## Subcommands

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [completion](nemau_completion.md) | Generate the autocompletion script for the specified shell |
| [compute](nemau_compute.md) | Instances, images, flavors, keypairs |
| [dns](nemau_dns.md) | DNS zones and records |
| [export](nemau_export.md) | Export the project's infrastructure as Terraform |
| [kubernetes](nemau_kubernetes.md) | Managed Kubernetes clusters |
| [load-balancer](nemau_load-balancer.md) | Load balancers, listeners, TLS certificates, pools and health monitors |
| [metering](nemau_metering.md) | Consumption, cost and billing events |
| [network](nemau_network.md) | Networks, subnets, floating IPs, security groups |
| [project](nemau_project.md) | Select and inspect the target project |
| [quota](nemau_quota.md) | Show the capacity limits applied to the target project |
| [region](nemau_region.md) | Regions and region health |
| [storage](nemau_storage.md) | Block volumes and object storage |
| [task](nemau_task.md) | Follow asynchronous operations |
| [whoami](nemau_whoami.md) | Show the API being targeted and the credential in use |

## Options

```
      --api-url string           API origin (default: $NEMAU_API_URL, then https://api.nemau-cloud.com)
      --idempotency-key string   key making a write safe to repeat: 1-128 characters of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : - (default: generated)
  -o, --output string            output format: table, json (default "table")
      --project string           target project, by id or by name (default: $NEMAU_PROJECT_ID, then the saved project)
  -q, --quiet                    print ids only
      --timeout duration         how long to wait for one operation (default 30m0s)
  -v, --version                  version for nemau
      --wait                     wait for asynchronous operations to finish (default true)
```
